newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-SIERRA LEONE MATCHES SHIFTED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SIERRA LEONE MATCHES SHIFTED.

text.p: Sierra Leone's remaining matches in the African Nations Cup qualifying competition have been shifted to neutral Mali, the Confederation of African Football (CAF) said on Monday.

The Leone Stars, who need to win both game to qualify for the Nations Cup finals in Burkina Faso next February, will play Tunisia in Bamako on July 23 and then Guinea at the same venue four days later.

CAF, who had given the Sierra Leone Football Association an ultimatum on the hosting of the games in Freetown, said the fighting following the coup d'etat in the west African country made the staging of the matches there impossible.
"We have rescheduled the matches after a thorough analysis of the situation," said a press communique.
Sierra Leone trail Tunisia and Guinea in the group four standings. Two of the three teams will qualify for the finals.
